posts.title: Introduction to Django Framework
posts.author: Subash Dhami
posts.description: Learn Django basics and framework structure.
posts.content:
Django is a high-level Python web framework that encourages rapid development and clean design.

Why Django?

Django follows MTV architecture and provides security features.

Getting Started


pip install django
django-admin startproject myproject
python manage.py runserver

Conclusion

Django is powerful for modern web development.
